g.text: Capacitor series and parallel equivalents follow charge and voltage constraints

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Series floating intermediate node with zero net initial charge gives equal plate-charge magnitude; parallel capacitors share voltage. Equivalent terminal
energy for this initially uncharged network is W=½C_eqV²; at 10 V, series stores 60 µJ and parallel 250 µJ.
